original.statement: The Helm value `hubble.relay.dialTimeout` has been deprecated in Cilium 1.17.0 (now a no-op) and will be removed in Cilium 1.18.

decision.reason: [ev-4ce2886cea1f] says the Helm option `hubble.relay.dialTimeout` is deprecated, is now a no-op, and will be removed in 1.18. It names no replacement. Only environments that explicitly set this value are affected, because their setting no longer has any effect and will later be removed. Environments that leave it unset are not affected. [ev-39a22d88e2f5] confirms the key still exists in the 1.17.0 values, so values-key{hubble.relay.dialTimeout, set} matches exactly the set of exposed environments.
